design.name: Monolith Glass
design.note: Trust blue tints the background and chrome only. Red, amber and green are reserved for states; cyan is reserved for interaction.

fusion.name: Pleats + Monolith (fusion of directions 1 and 3, 15/11)
fusion.note: Light glass for context; the dark stone surface only for what demands action now (CRITICAL). Warm field = criticality of the day, cool field = link to ground. State colours below are the light-background variants (contrast >= 4.5:1 on the glass).

chart.note: Light-background chart colours: series 14.4:1, requirement line 5.9:1, flagged 6.2:1 on white (graphics need 3:1). The dark-theme cyan #00E0F5 is 1.6:1 on white.

navy.note: Dark glass on navy (19/11, validated by Joseph). Panel luminance under any text stays <= 0.07; coral only for DEGRADED/urgent; cream is the action and focus colour.
